reason: I'd probably throw one messy client at the free 40 documents to see if it really reads the Indonesian nota, but I won't pay for something capped at 5 groups when I have 20 clients. Juggling four Google accounts and four subscriptions just to keep clients separate is more admin, not less.
objection: It's built for one business owner, not a firm. I need 20 clients cleanly separated, each in its own sheet I can hand over, and no export to Jurnal or Accurate means I'm still copying rows at month end.
would_change_my_mind: An accountant plan: unlimited client groups under one login, a separate sheet per client, and pricing per client that I can pass into my monthly fee.
